name: Timberborn
tested_iphone: runs on iPhone 17 (1.1.2, Steam): a save plays, but the bottom tool bar sits under the iOS home gesture and is hard to use.
why: The local HTTP API builds its pages with Handlebars.Net, which compiles templates to delegates with 'in' parameters at runtime; IL2CPP's expression interpreter cannot create those ('byref delegate'). Guarding the page loaders lets a game load; only the optional HTTP API pages are lost. ModCodeStarter.LoadAssemblies is guarded so a mod DLL that was not compiled into the port is logged and skipped instead of stopping the game at the mod manager.
